claims.statement: For every balanced uniform-cube Boolean f, the KL of the pushforwards of the spectral law P and its influence-matched maximum-entropy law Q_r under Z_f=(sign of integer Walsh coefficient, 2-adic valuation, occupancy counts in exact equal-influence coordinate classes) is a nonnegative data-processing reserve K_SVIC<=K_occ. The exact loss is the P_Z-average of log2 fiber size minus the entropy of the squared odd-part distribution on that fiber.
claims.scope: balanced uniform-cube Boolean functions; exact uniform Walsh lattice
claims.verification: analytic proof in REPORT.md; finite diagnostics are supplementary

claims.statement: For every one-point-defect suspension F_m(y,x)=y(1-2 1_{x=0}), m>=2, K_SVIC(F_m)=K_occ(F_m), hence K_SVIC/I = m-5+1/ln2+o(1).

For every depth m recursive ternary majority M_m, every nonzero Walsh coefficient is a signed power of two and all coordinate influences equal 2^{-m}; therefore K_SVIC(M_m)=K_occ(M_m) exactly at every depth.
claims.verification: analytic induction on the recursive majority Fourier expansion; CHECK.py diagnostics depths 1..2

claims.statement: Determine whether the exact odd-part anisotropy loss Delta_odd=K_occ-K_SVIC is O(I), or otherwise paid by retained hierarchy/signed-Booleanity credits, in the dangerous balanced deficit region; otherwise construct a genuine Boolean counterfamily with Delta_odd/I unbounded.

consumed_partner.applied_expression: The exact q-flip channel average is a strictly radial Walsh multiplier K_{n-1}(|T|); this identifies the Hamming-layer coordinate as physical. The present reserve retains that radial information but uses KL/logarithmic weighting and signed Walsh valuation instead of unweighted channel counting.
